experiment: E52, experiments/baseline_neurons (B2 + B3 + B4 of the baselines scoping plan)
filed: 2026-10-29, before any run; never edited after the run (a dated report instead)

states.source: E12's fine-tunes as regenerated by E46 stage 0a (~/commute-data/results-large/regating_table/{name}.pt, delta-W of the 24 matrices, fp32); copy = E12's 'existing' class (identity tables M x -> x), cipher = E12's 'new' class (random bijections M x -> pi(x)): experiments/new_vs_existing/run.py line 54 and 146-147, commute.anchors.KV_TASKS (cls 'copy' / 'random'), E51's predictions.json 'definitions.states'. code_step10 = E36's code-text fine-tune at step 10 (learned nothing; E46 measured its per-token held-out gain at -0.0516 nats, bf16).

settings.precision: fp32 throughout, no autocast, TF32 off
settings.windows: each task's held-out windows from windows_<task>.pt (100 per task, 41 tokens, marker at 19, key at 20, answer read from the logits at position 20, target table[key]); fit half = held-out windows 0, 2, 4, ... (50), scoring half = 1, 3, 5, ... (50)
settings.gain: G = mean over all 100 held-out windows of log P_tuned(target) - log P_W0(target) at the answer position; G_fit, G_score the same over each half. Every share = mean over the scoring half of (log P_method - log P_W0) / G_score (the B3 layer choice uses the fit half and G_fit).
settings.floor: per task: floor = max(0.05, 2 x |G(s0) - G(s1)|); code_step10 has one seed, so its floor is 0.05. A state is 'no change' iff |G| < floor (strict); its shares are reported, not scored.

b2.neurons: the 3072 GELU outputs (inputs of down_proj) of each of the 4 blocks, 12288 in all
b2.shift: mean over the fit half, at the answer position, of tuned minus W0 activation
b2.rank: by |shift|, descending, stable sort (ties: lower flat index first; flat index = layer x 3072 + neuron)
b2.patch: the top-k neurons take the tuned model's activations (from the tuned model's own forward on the same window) at every position of the W0 forward; scored on the scoring half
b2.k50: smallest k on the grid with share >= 0.5; infinity if none
b2.idle: of the top 16, the fraction whose mean over the fit half of |W0 activation| at the answer position is < 0.1 x that neuron's 99th percentile of |W0 activation| over every position of Pile rows val 0..63 (32768 positions)

b3.vector: v_l = mean over the fit half of (tuned - W0) residual stream at the answer position, at block l's input
b3.apply: W0 with v_l added to block l's input at the answer position only
b3.choice: the layer with the largest fit-half share (G_fit denominator); ties to the lower layer; S = that layer's scoring-half share. Block 0's input is the token embedding, which no fine-tune changes, so v_0 = 0 and its share is 0 (a built-in check, reported).

b4.demonstration: the triple (marker, key, table[key]) of 3 tokens
b4.prompt: n demonstrations, then the window's tokens 0..20 (Pile text, marker, query key); the answer read at the last position
b4.keys: the n demonstration keys are drawn without replacement from the task's 31 other keys (the query's key is never among them), by torch.randperm with a generator seeded 1000 * n + window index
b4.share: (log P_W0,prompted - log P_W0) / G_score per state; the numerator is the same for a task's two seeds, the denominator is each seed's. n = 0 reads W0 on the truncated window: expected 0 (reported).

settings.code_step10: G over code_held.pt (64 held-out code rows of 512 tokens): mean over rows and the 511 next-token positions of log P_tuned - log P_W0, fp32. No method is run on it (B4 has no demonstrations for a free-text task, and B2/B3's 'answer position' does not exist); its verdict comes from the floor rule alone.

stage0.order: first, alone; a miss stops the job (exit 1) before any method stage
stage0.identity_patch: W0 with all 12288 neurons replaced by W0's own activations from a separate forward, scoring windows of ident32 and rand32: max over windows |log P - log P_W0| <= 1e-4 nats
stage0.full_patch: W0 with block 3's output replaced at every position by the tuned model's (ident32_s0 and rand32_s0, scoring half): share within 1e-3 of 1

rule.separation: for a number X over the scored states (those not 'no change'): gap = mean_copy(X) - mean_cipher(X); spread = max(range_copy, range_cipher), range = max - min within a kind; separates iff |gap| > spread (strict). Passes iff it separates in the stated direction; a separation in the other direction is verdict 'reversed' (fails the prediction, reported loudly). Fewer than 2 scored states in a kind: verdict 'not scored' (fails). A non-finite X stops the scoring with an error.
rule.k50_scale: k50 is scored as its grid index: k = 1, 4, 16, 64, 256, 12288 -> 0..5, infinity -> 6 (so infinity is one grid step past 'all' and every value is finite)
rule.edge_cases_checked_before_filing: all eight equal (gap 0, spreads 0) -> does not separate; kinds constant but different (spreads 0, gap > 0) -> separates; gap equal to the larger spread -> does not separate; k50 infinite in all eight (index 6 everywhere) -> does not separate; k50 infinite for every cipher and finite for every copy -> separates, copy lower; one state below its floor -> scored over the other seven; a kind with one or zero scored states -> 'not scored'; G = 0 or negative: |G| < floor gives 'no change' (no division), a negative G with |G| >= floor keeps its share (the method's change over the state's change, signed); idle share ties (exactly 0.1 x q99) count as not idle (strict <); a neuron with q99 = 0 is idle only if its mean |activation| is < 0, i.e. never
rule.decision_tree_reads: P1-P3 'separates' for the tree = verdict 'pass' or 'reversed' (either direction separates the kinds); P4 must 'pass'

P1.why: neurons are shared across the tasks' answers and the cipher may use as few neurons as the copy

P3.why: a single vector can push a mode (copy the key) but cannot encode a 32-word cipher

P4.why: the labels were built this way

P5.claim: |G| < 0.05 (its floor), so every method reads it as 'no change'
P5.note_at_filing: E46 measured G = -0.0516 on the same rows in bf16, 0.0016 above this floor; the fp32 reading here may fall either side

decision_tree.P4 fails (fail, reversed or not scored): the labels are not what we think: stop and tell the user
decision_tree.P4 passes and none of P1-P3 separates: the neuron and activation baselines do not separate the kinds where VPD's route split does: the first point in VPD's favour; write it up
decision_tree.P4 passes and any of P1-P3 separates: that baseline separates as well as the route split: write it up as the objection holding on this set; propose the size-matched pair and the mixed case (new /design items)

blind_spots: B2 patches activations, not weights: it cannot separate an MLP change from an attention change upstream. B3 is blind to input-dependent changes by construction. B4 is blind to anything not expressible as in-context examples.
reported_not_scored: share per k for every state
B3 share per layer, fit and scoring half
G, G_fit, G_score and floor per state
